lines.text: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour, and seven angels received trumpets.
An angel with a golden censer offered much incense with the prayers of all the saints, and the smoke rose before God.
The angel filled the censer with fire from the altar and hurled it to the earth, and there was an earthquake.
At the first trumpet hail and fire mixed with blood fell, and at the second a burning mountain turned a third of the sea to blood, destroying a third of the chariots.
The star Wormwood fell on a third of the rivers, and an eagle cried woe over the trumpets of the remaining two angels.
